steps.message: What is on my schedule for Friday at 10:00am in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|fossify|calendar'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|fossify|calendar'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell 'dow=$(date +%u); add=$(( (5 - dow + 7) % 7 )); target_date=$(date -d "+$add day" +%Y-%m-%d); begin_s=$(date -d "$target_date 10:00:00" +%s); end_s=$((begin_s+60)); begin_ms=$((begin_s*1000)); end_ms=$((end_s*1000)); echo "TARGET=$target_date 10:00 UTC"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$begin_ms/$end_ms --projection title:begin:end 2>/dev/null || content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$begin_ms/$end_ms'

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell 'dow=$(date +%u); add=$(( (5 - dow + 7) % 7 )); target_date=$(date -d "+$add day" +%Y-%m-%d); begin_s=$(date -d "$target_date 10:00:00" +%s); end_s=$((begin_s+60)); begin_ms=$((begin_s*1000)); end_ms=$((end_s*1000)); echo "TARGET=$target_date 10:00 UTC"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$begin_ms/$end_ms --projection title:begin:end 2>/dev/null || content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$begin_ms/$end_ms'"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell 'now=$(date +%s); dow=$(date +%u); add=$(( (5 - dow + 7) % 7 )); day_start=$(( now - (now % 86400) )); begin_s=$(( day_start + add*86400 + 10*3600 )); end_s=$(( begin_s + 3600 )); begin_ms=$(( begin_s*1000 )); end_ms=$(( end_s*1000 )); echo "BEGIN_S=$begin_s END_S=$end_s"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$begin_ms/$end_ms --projection title:begin:end'

steps.message: Execute: adb shell 'now=$(date +%s); dow=$(date +%u); add=$(( (5 - dow + 7) % 7 )); day_start=$(( now - (now % 86400) )); fri0=$(( day_start + add*86400 )); sat0=$(( fri0 + 86400 )); fri0ms=$(( fri0*1000 )); sat0ms=$(( sat0*1000 )); tenms=$(( (fri0+36000)*1000 )); echo "FRI0=$fri0 SAT0=$sat0 TEN=$((fri0+36000))"; echo "--CALENDARS--"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:visible:sync_events; echo "--INSTANCES_FRIDAY--"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$fri0ms/$sat0ms --projection title:begin:end:allDay:calendar_id; echo "--EVENTS_OVERLAP_FRIDAY--"; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id:title:dtstart:dtend:allDay:calendar_id --where "dtstart < $sat0ms AND (dtend IS NULL OR dtend > $fri0ms)"'
